Name: Marnie's Auto-Petter
Author: blueOstrich
Description:
Marnie's shop sells auto-petters for 75,000 gold, which is 50% higher than Joja Mart's price. I didn't include an option to bypass the Community Center completion or the cost of the auto-petters to make the mod feel more balanced. 
﻿There are other mods that add other common items to the inventory of shops, including Improved Shops from milosnikwiewiorek and Shops Expanded from scarboy17. They also make auto-petters available for purchase, but I wanted this mod to make the game just a little easier.

Downloads.Description: Contains the manifest.json and content.json files.
